put.summary: Add or replace the meeting transcript
put.description:
PUT, not POST: a meeting has exactly one transcript, and sending the same
body twice leaves the same state (idempotent).

post.summary: Queue AI extraction of summary, decisions, and action items
post.description:
Returns immediately. Poll ``GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}`` for the outcome.

Submitting again while a job for this meeting is still queued or running
returns that same job rather than starting a duplicate.

Results are ordered by cosine similarity (``score``, higher is closer).

Only meetings the user can access are searched, and only chunks built from
the meeting's current transcript. A meeting becomes searchable once it has
been processed.

ActionItemUpdateRequest.title: ActionItemUpdateRequest
ActionItemUpdateRequest.description:
Human corrections to an extracted action item. Every field optional.

``deadline`` and ``priority`` may be set to null deliberately (to clear
them); ``task`` and ``status`` may not.

next_attempt_at.title: Next Attempt At
next_attempt_at.description: When a QUEUED job becomes runnable (later than now after a failed attempt).

error.description: For FAILED jobs, the final error. For a QUEUED job that already failed once, the error that caused the retry.

MeetingUpdateRequest.title: MeetingUpdateRequest
MeetingUpdateRequest.description:
Partial update - every field optional.

Distinguishing "field absent" from "field set to null" is done with
``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`` in the route, so PATCH with an empty
body is a no-op rather than wiping the record.

ProcessSubmissionResponse.title: ProcessSubmissionResponse
ProcessSubmissionResponse.description:
Response to POST /meetings/{id}/process.

* 202 with ``job`` set: work was queued (or an identical job was already
  active and is returned instead of starting a duplicate).
* 200 with ``job`` null and ``cached`` true: stored results are already
  current for this transcript, prompt, and model. Nothing was queued.

is_stale.title: Is Stale
is_stale.description: True when the transcript has changed since this summary was generated.

content.title: Content
content.description: Plain-text transcript. Speaker labels such as 'Priya:' improve owner extraction.

replace_manual_transcript.title: Replace Manual Transcript
replace_manual_transcript.description: A typed/pasted transcript normally takes precedence over a recording. Set true to discard it and transcribe the recording instead.

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Checked early for a friendly error; storage enforces the real limit.

UploadUrlResponse.title: UploadUrlResponse
UploadUrlResponse.description:
Everything the browser needs to upload directly to storage.

Send a multipart/form-data POST to ``upload_url`` containing every entry in
``fields`` followed by the file under the name ``file``. Then call
``POST /meetings/{id}/media/complete`` with ``upload_token``.
